title: JSON STREAM PIPELINE — stop editing JS. Inject raw into JSON. Gaia places it.
summary: From here on out: inject raw into JSON stream. Gaia picks it up and places it. The JS modules are ORGANS — built. The JSON is FOOD — flows through. She uses dots and hooks and slashes to build the JSON and the HTMLs. She understands what is card and what isn't. Stop manually checking line counts. The health monitor does that. Stop editing JS unless splitting anacondas.

the_rule.never: Never edit JS to add data. Never add logic to add content.
the_rule.always: Always inject new concepts as JSON brain thoughts.
the_rule.why: The organs (JS) are built. The food (JSON) flows through. Adding food to an organ makes it fat (anaconda).
the_rule.how: Write thought-NNN-name.json → gaia-null-code.js auto-discovers → gaiaIngest fires → all modules react

the_pipeline.step_1: New concept arrives (from Kevin, from feeds, from agents)
the_pipeline.step_6: All hooked modules react: locality, hearing, tense, identity
the_pipeline.step_7: Data appears on globe, in overlays, in desk messages
the_pipeline.no_js_touched: Zero JS files edited. Zero risk of anaconda growth.

url_anatomy_as_json_grammar.slash: / = directory separator = path to the data
url_anatomy_as_json_grammar.question: ? = query = what do you want to know
url_anatomy_as_json_grammar.ampersand: & = join = connect two pieces of data
url_anatomy_as_json_grammar.hash: # = anchor = where to pin the data on the globe

card_vs_not_card.card: A JSON object with id, title, and connections. It has IDENTITY.
card_vs_not_card.not_card: Raw data without structure. Numbers, arrays, blobs.
card_vs_not_card.transformation: Gaia takes not-card and MAKES it card by adding id + connections.
card_vs_not_card.the_dots: The dots (.) in JSON ARE the cell membranes between fields.
card_vs_not_card.the_hooks: The hooks (?) in URLs ARE the query membrane that filters what you see.

existing_auto_loaders: gaia-boot.js → 9 data loaders for identity, tree, reality, dreams, flavors, beacons, solar, health, taxonomy
gaiaIngest chain → locality → tense → hearing → identity all react
what_this_means: From NOW on, every new idea = a new JSON file. The existing JS organs read it. The existing hooks fire. The existing overlays display it. NO NEW JS. NO JS EDITS (except splitting anacondas). JSON IS THE FOOD. JS IS THE GUT.
